thread:
erin: Quick sync  QuasarEdge agreed to be a short customer vignette + webinar callout. We need: a one-line approved quote, consent to use clips/logo, a recording slot, and webinar lead routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/quasaredge-brief

chao: I can run the interview. Chao (CS) free Fri 11am PT for 20-25m. Will prep 3 talking points: cost, latency, dev lift.

mira: Producer here  Fri 11am PT works. I'll set Zoom + Otter, plan a 75s promo and a 15s teaser, plus captions. Do we want B-roll or just headshot?

erin: Short promo only. Ask for logo and one high-res headshot. Also need the short hero quote for the case page (1 sentence).

jasper-sales: For routing, create leads with utm_campaign=quasar-edge-launch and hidden field product_interest=quasar_edge. SF queue = SDR_QuasarEdge. Add tag "webinar_quasar_edge". If company_size > 500, route to AE queue.

olivia-legal: Legal checklist: 1) explicit consent wording required covering case page, social, webinar repurposing, and short clips; 2) any metric must include measurement window and note it's from aggregated production workload; 3) remove any forward-looking or comparative vendor claims. Paste the exact final quote here when you have it.

chao: Draft quote to propose on call: "QuasarEdge reduced our inference spend by ~47% and brought p95 latency down from ~780ms to ~210ms across our October production workload." I'll ask them to shorten.

mira: Recommend asking for a 1-line hero variant during the call (easier for legal). I'll request permission to use logo and a 75s cut and 15s teaser.

erin: Also confirm they gave only aggregated metrics (no raw logs). If they did share logs we'd need a DPA.

chao: They confirm only aggregated metrics were shared. No raw logs.

press-bot: Reminder: submit /legal-review with the consent text + final quote. SLA 48h.

olivia-legal: Once you post the shortened quote and consent, I'll review and return any redlines within 48 hours. Standard perpetual marketing usage is OK unless they request embargo.

erin: Action items:
- Chao: capture 1-line exec quote + explicit consent + logo permission on call (due EOD Fri)
- Mira: calendar invite + recording + captions + promo edit plan (invite sent)
- Jasper: setup form fields + SF queue wiring (SDR_QuasarEdge + product_interest + utm); AE reroute rule
- Olivia: legal review once short quote submitted (48h SLA)

jasper-sales: I'll add the form fields and automations today and DM the mapping to ops.

chao: Reached out to QuasarEdge contact; they'll confirm the one-line quote and consent after the call.

mira: Sent invite and prep doc (3 talking points, ask to approve the 75s cut on the call).

olivia-legal: Noted. If the quote references specific months, include the month in the text (e.g., "October production workload").

erin: Tentative timeline: publish case vignette next Wednesday, social promo same day, webinar ~7 business days after publish. If legal redlines, shift by a week.

press-bot: Task created: "QuasarEdge case + legal review" assigned to olivia-legal, due in 48h after submission.
